title.zh: CME Group to List Bitcoin Cash and Uniswap Futures Oct. 19
title.en: CME Group to List Bitcoin Cash and Uniswap Futures Oct. 19

current_state.zh: CME拟上市比特币现金和Uniswap期货的公告已引发市场反应：比特币现金收涨27%，比特币SV涨20%，Uniswap冲高回落；上市仍定于10月19日。
current_state.en: CME Group's announced Bitcoin Cash and Uniswap futures listing has triggered a market rally: Bitcoin Cash closed up 27%, Bitcoin SV rose 20%, and Uniswap spiked before giving back gains; listing remains scheduled for Oct. 19.

updates.title_zh: Bitcoin Cash Runs 27% on CME Futures Listing as Bitcoin Gives Up the Day
updates.title_en: Bitcoin Cash Runs 27% on CME Futures Listing as Bitcoin Gives Up the Day
updates.what_changed_zh: CME公告拟上市比特币现金期货后，比特币现金盘中上涨14%，收盘涨27%，成交量超周一两倍；比特币SV上涨20%，Uniswap一度涨11%后回吐涨幅。
updates.what_changed_en: After CME announced it would list Bitcoin Cash futures, Bitcoin Cash rose 14% intraday, closed up 27% on more than twice Monday's volume; Bitcoin SV rose 20%, and Uniswap spiked 11% before giving back gains.
updates.current_state_zh: CME拟上市比特币现金和Uniswap期货的公告已引发市场反应：比特币现金收涨27%，比特币SV涨20%，Uniswap冲高回落；上市仍定于10月19日。
